ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 10,000 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so cold viewers miss it. Put that figure in the first line of each creative, and open one ad with a quote from Anya Garnis.
Your site offers a 60 day guarantee, yet only 5 of 30 ads mention it, so buyers may leave before the offer. Put the 60 day guarantee in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.
14 of 30 copy ads open on the same picky eater question, so viewers without that worry scroll past. Name two new angles from your product, such as the price objection, and run them against it.
One exact copy runs in 11 of 30 ads, so every repeat view shows identical words. Keep the body copy, rewrite the opening line around the price objection, and swap the image for each of the 11 ads.
